Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes/sirens: Israeli cities continue to report missile and drone counterstrikes from Iran, Hezbollah and allied groups. Northern border sees daily exchanges.
  • Air campaign: US/Israeli airstrikes continue inside Iran. Previous 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Pause & diplomacy: Trump announced a SECOND pause on strikes against Iranian energy targets — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET — citing an Iranian request. Tehran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Northern Border (Hezbollah): Daily rocket/missile fire and Israeli strikes. Elevated alert in northern communities.
  • Hormuz & maritime: Iran permits passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Shipping risk elevated for non‑approved carriers.
  • Airspace & transport: Regional airports (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan) under repeated closures; commercial flights heavily disrupted.
  • Domestic situation in Iran: Week‑long mourning for Khamenei. State rhetoric stresses continuity and revenge — risk of intensified retaliation.
  • International actions: Turkey intervening politically to preserve the pause. Some allied air movements visible in flight data; heightened NATO diplomatic focus on Iran at Ankara talks.
  • Warnings for civilians: Expect intermittent sirens, checkpoints and travel disruptions. Keep emergency plans ready.
  • 🟢 Good News: A 10‑day pause on energy strikes announced and Pakistan engaging as mediator — diplomatic window opened.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
